title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Claude Academy Launches & Caura MCP: Anthropic introduced Claude Academy for structured learning paths, while Caura launched single-command MCP memory for AI agent fleets.
DeepSeek v4 Flash Compute Bottleneck: OpenCode reported DeepSeek v4 Flash volume spiked 6x to 18T tokens/day before capacity limits forced a 5x price hike, leaving a 10T token/day gap.
OpenAI Releases GPT-Image-2 & Banked Quota Reset: OpenAI launched transparent image generation in ChatGPT/API and offered banked quota resets as Codex hit 20M active weekly users.
Marvell Breaks Broadcom’s TPU Monopoly: Google officially announced a partnership with Marvell for custom AI chips, challenging Broadcom’s historic TPU monopoly.
FIFA Issues Major Suspensions & GTA VI Netflix Special: FIFA handed down 10-match bans following the Argentina-Spain clash, while Rockstar announced a GTA VI Netflix preview for Aug 27.

items.title: @claudeai: Claude Academy Officially Launches
items.body: Anthropic released Claude Academy, offering structured, interactive learning pathways tailored for both beginners and experienced developers.

items.title: @jayair: DeepSeek v4 Flash Surges to 18T Tokens/Day Before Price Hike
items.body: OpenCode analysis detailed how DeepSeek v4 Flash grew 6x in 2 weeks to 18T tokens/day before GPU constraints forced a 5x peak price hike, creating a massive 10T token/day void in low-cost inference.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Introduces Transparent Image Support in GPT-Image-2
items.body: OpenAI lead Tibo announced native alpha channel transparency support for image creation across ChatGPT and the GPT-Image-2 API.

items.title: @MaxForAI: OpenAI Codex Crosses 20M Users and Grants Banked Quota Resets
items.body: OpenAI Codex reached 20M weekly active users, prompting OpenAI to issue selectable banked quota resets for ChatGPT Work and Codex subscribers following rate-limit feedback.

items.title: @davis7: Ox Alpha Reaches 80% Solve Rate on DeepSWE Benchmark
items.body: Evaluations on real-world software engineering tasks showed Ox Alpha achieving an 80% success rate on DeepSWE, outperforming Fable 5 Max and GLM-5.3.

items.title: @CauraAI: Caura Ships Single-Command Agent Fleet Memory for Claude
items.body: Caura launched a single-line MCP command letting entire agent fleets share structured, permissioned memory with full origin provenance.

items.title: @Balder13946731: Google Taps Marvell for Custom AI Chips, Breaking Broadcom Monopoly
items.body: Google officially announced a custom AI chip partnership with Marvell (MRVL), challenging Broadcom’s (AVGO) decade-long dominance over Google TPU supply.

items.title: @maitian99: Citadel CEO Internal Email Leaked
items.body: An internal memo from Citadel’s CEO leaked, confirming recent strategic positioning and macro equity market exposure shifts.

items.title: @PIF_en: Saudi Public Investment Fund Releases 2025 Financial Report
items.body: Saudi Arabia’s PIF published its annual report highlighting robust portfolio returns and expanded allocations into global tech and energy infrastructure.

items.title: @StrongandSafeNY: New York Energy Bill & Escrow Hikes Spark Debate
items.body: Policy analysts highlighted growing voter concern over 48 consecutive energy rate adjustments and rising property tax burdens across New York State.

items.title: @AYi_AInotes: OpenAI API Proxy Crackdown Triggers User Debate
items.body: Strict enforcement against Sub2API proxying brought anti-abuse measures and seat-licensing restrictions into focus among developer teams.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: FIFA Hands Down 10-Game Ban After Argentina-Spain Clash
items.body: FIFA officially announced disciplinary bans following the Argentina vs Spain match, suspending Leandro Paredes for 10 games and Nahuel Molina for 7.

items.title: @RockstarGames: Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look Set for Netflix Premiere
items.body: Rockstar Games revealed that "Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look" will premiere on Netflix on Thursday, August 27 at 3:00 PM ET.

items.title: @FCBayernEN: FC Bayern Tributes Lewandowski Birthday & Olise Highlight
items.body: Bayern Munich celebrated former star striker Robert Lewandowski’s birthday alongside viral highlights from Michael Olise’s post-match interview.

items.title: @MLB: Tarik Skubal Records First Strikeout in Dodgers Uniform
items.body: Major League Baseball showcased high-speed camera footage of Cy Young contender Tarik Skubal’s dominant first strikeout for Los Angeles.

items.title: @oooodjdjd: ByteDance Founder’s Career Principles Gain Traction
items.body: A viral breakdown of ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming’s early career speeches resurfaced, highlighting ownership mindset and problem-solving depth.
